theorem div_gcd_dvd_of_dvd_mul {e m n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (he : e ∣ m * n) :
    e / Nat.gcd e m ∣ n := by

have hdiv : Nat.lcm e m ∣ m * n := Nat.lcm_dvd he (Nat.dvd_mul_right m n)
  have hid : Nat.lcm e m = m * (e / Nat.gcd e m) := by
    rw [Nat.lcm_eq_mul_div, Nat.mul_comm e m,

  exact Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left hm hdiv

theorem gcd_quotient_split_injective (m : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun e : ℕ => (Nat.gcd e m, e / Nat.gcd e m)) := by

intro e f h
  calc
    e = Nat.gcd e m * (e / Nat.gcd e m) :=
      (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left e m)).symm
    _ = Nat.gcd f m * (f / Nat.gcd f m) :=

theorem fouvryTau_mul_argument_le {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    ∀ {m n : ℕ}, 0 < m → 0 < n →
      fouvryTau j (m * n) ≤ fouvryTau j m * fouvryTau j n := by
complete_actual_declarations.complete_actual_body:
obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : j ≠ 0)
  clear hj
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro m n hm hn
      simp only [fouvryTau_order_one (Nat.mul_pos hm hn).ne',
        fouvryTau_order_one hm.ne', fouvryTau_order_one hn.ne', mul_one, le_refl]
  | succ k ih =>
      intro m n hm hn
      let splitDivisor : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ := fun e => (Nat.gcd e m, e / Nat.gcd e m)
      have hinj : Function.Injective splitDivisor := gcd_quotient_split_injective m
      have hmaps : ((m * n).divisors.image splitDivisor) ⊆ m.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
        exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
          ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨Nat.gcd_dvd_right e m, hm.ne'⟩,
            Nat.mem_divisors.mpr
              ⟨div_gcd_dvd_of_dvd_mul hm (Nat.mem_divisors.mp he).1, hn.ne'⟩⟩
      have hpoint : ∀ e ∈ (m * n).divisors,
          fouvryTau (k + 1) e ≤
            fouvryTau (k + 1) (splitDivisor e).1 * fouvryTau (k + 1) (splitDivisor e).2 := by
        intro e he
        have hepos : 0 < e := Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors he
        simpa only [splitDivisor, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left e m)] using
          (ih (m := Nat.gcd e m) (n := e / Nat.gcd e m)
            (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left m hepos) (Nat.div_gcd_pos_of_pos_left m hepos))
      calc
        fouvryTau (k + 1 + 1) (m * n) =
            ∑ e ∈ (m * n).divisors, fouvryTau (k + 1) e := fouvryTau_succ _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ (m * n).divisors,
            fouvryTau (k + 1) (splitDivisor e).1 * fouvryTau (k + 1) (splitDivisor e).2 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
        _ = ∑ z ∈ (m * n).divisors.image splitDivisor,
            fouvryTau (k + 1) z.1 * fouvryTau (k + 1) z.2 :=
          (Finset.sum_image hinj.injOn).symm
        _ ≤ ∑ z ∈ m.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors,
            fouvryTau (k + 1) z.1 * fouvryTau (k + 1) z.2 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hmaps (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
        _ = (∑ g ∈ m.divisors, fouvryTau (k + 1) g) *
            (∑ h ∈ n.divisors, fouvryTau (k + 1) h) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_product]
          exact (Finset.sum_mul_sum _ _ _ _).symm
        _ = fouvryTau (k + 1 + 1) m * fouvryTau (k + 1 + 1) n := by
          rw [← fouvryTau_succ (k + 1) m, ← fouvryTau_succ (k + 1) n]

spans.literal_source: def fouvryTau (k : ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℕ := ArithmeticFunction.zeta ^ k

theorem fouvryTau_order_one {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : fouvryTau 1 n = 1 := by
  simp [fouvryTau, ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply, hn]

theorem fouvryTau_succ (k n : ℕ) :
    fouvryTau (k + 1) n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, fouvryTau k d := by
  exact ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply (f := fouvryTau k)

theorem fouvryTau_mul_le (k l n : ℕ) :
    fouvryTau k n * fouvryTau l n ≤ fouvryTau (k * l) n := by
theorem lcm_eq_mul_div (m n : Nat) : lcm m n = m * n / gcd m n := rfl

theorem lcm_dvd {m n k : Nat} (H1 : m ∣ k) (H2 : n ∣ k) : lcm m n ∣ k := by
  match eq_zero_or_pos k with
  | .inl h => rw [h]; exact Nat.dvd_zero _
  | .inr kpos =>
    apply Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left (gcd_pos_of_pos_left n (pos_of_dvd_of_pos H1 kpos))
    rw [gcd_mul_lcm, ← gcd_mul_right, Nat.mul_comm n k]
    exact dvd_gcd (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ H2) (Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right H1 _)
protected theorem dvd_mul_right (a b : Nat) : a ∣ a * b := ⟨b, rfl⟩

protected theorem mul_div_cancel' {n m : Nat} (H : n ∣ m) : n * (m / n) = m := by
  have := mod_add_div m n
  rwa [mod_eq_zero_of_dvd H, Nat.zero_add] at this

protected theorem dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left
    (kpos : 0 < k) (H : k * m ∣ k * n) : m ∣ n := by
  let ⟨l, H⟩ := H
  rw [Nat.mul_assoc] at H
  exact ⟨_, Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left kpos H⟩

protected theorem mul_div_assoc (m : Nat) (H : k ∣ n) : m * n / k = m * (n / k) := by
  match Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with
  | .inl h0 => rw [h0, Nat.div_zero, Nat.div_zero, Nat.mul_zero]
  | .inr hpos =>
    have h1 : m * n / k = m * (n / k * k) / k := by rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel H]
    rw [h1, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ hpos]

theorem gcd_dvd_left (m n : Nat) : gcd m n ∣ m := (gcd_dvd m n).left

theorem gcd_dvd_right (m n : Nat) : gcd m n ∣ n := (gcd_dvd m n).right

theorem gcd_pos_of_pos_left {m : Nat} (n : Nat) (mpos : 0 < m) : 0 < gcd m n :=
  pos_of_dvd_of_pos (gcd_dvd_left m n) mpos

theorem gcd_pos_of_pos_right (m : Nat) {n : Nat} (npos : 0 < n) : 0 < gcd m n :=
  pos_of_dvd_of_pos (gcd_dvd_right m n) npos

theorem div_gcd_pos_of_pos_left (b : Nat) (h : 0 < a) : 0 < a / a.gcd b :=
  (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le <| Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ h).2 (Nat.one_mul _ ▸ Nat.gcd_le_left _ h)

theorem mem_divisors {m : ℕ} : n ∈ divisors m ↔ n ∣ m ∧ m ≠ 0 := by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm); · simp [divisors]
  simp only [hm, Ne, not_false_iff, and_true, ← filter_dvd_eq_divisors hm, mem_filter,
    mem_range, and_iff_right_iff_imp, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
  exact le_of_dvd hm.bot_lt

theorem pos_of_mem_divisors {m : ℕ} (h : m ∈ n.divisors) : 0 < m := by
  cases m
  · rw [mem_divisors, zero_dvd_iff (a := n)] at h
    cases h.2 h.1
  apply Nat.succ_pos

/-- If a function is injective on a finset, products over the original finset or its image coincide.
See also `prod_image_of_pairwise_eq_one` for a version with weaker assumptions. -/
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /-- If a function is injective on a finset, sums over the original
finset or its image coincide.
See also `sum_image_of_pairwise_eq_zero` for a version with weaker assumptions. -/]
theorem prod_image [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset κ} {g : κ → ι} :
    Set.InjOn g s → ∏ x ∈ s.image g, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f (g x) :=
  fold_image

@[to_additive (attr := gcongr) sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg]
theorem prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le' [MulLeftMono N] (h : s ⊆ t)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → 1 ≤ f i) : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by
  classical calc
      ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ (∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i) * ∏ i ∈ s, f i :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_left' <| one_le_prod' <| by simpa only [mem_sdiff, and_imp]
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t \ s ∪ s, f i := (prod_union sdiff_disjoint).symm
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by rw [sdiff_union_of_subset h]

lemma sum_mul_sum (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f : ι → R) (g : κ → R) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * ∑ j ∈ t, g j = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, f i * g j := by
  simp_rw [sum_mul, ← mul_sum]

theorem exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero : ∀ {n}, n ≠ 0 → Exists fun k => n = succ k
  | _+1, _ => ⟨_, rfl⟩

@[to_additive /-- The sum over a product set equals the sum of the fiberwise sums. For rewriting
in the reverse direction, use `Finset.sum_product'` -/]
theorem prod_product (s : Finset γ) (t : Finset α) (f : γ × α → β) :
    ∏ x ∈ s ×ˢ t, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, ∏ y ∈ t, f (x, y) :=
  prod_finset_product (s ×ˢ t) s (fun _a => t) fun _p => mem_product
